name: Busa Agent Orders
description: Agent-channel orders and price guardrails for e-commerce sellers: orders that AI shopping agents (Meta Muse, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) bring in, with the price paid versus the price listed; per-SKU guardrails; a review queue for agent-proposed price changes; and order exceptions. The AirApp only records a person's decision; it never touches a store, a payment or a price.

label.zh-CN: 跑一遍本周的智能体订单复盘

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-agent-orders` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then import this week's agent-channel orders, open exceptions for anything paid below listed price or floor, and list the price proposals waiting for me.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先读这个文件夹里的 `busa-agent-orders` 技能并按它的流程做，然后导入本周的智能体渠道订单，对低于标价或最低价成交的开异常，并列出等我决定的改价提议。

label.en: Brief me on the agent channel
label.zh-CN: 给我讲讲智能体渠道现状

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-agent-orders` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then give me a short brief: orders and revenue by agent versus last week, open exceptions and their impact, and proposals that breach a guardrail.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先读这个文件夹里的 `busa-agent-orders` 技能并按它的流程做，然后给我一个简短汇报：各智能体的订单和收入与上周对比、待处理异常及影响、触碰护栏的改价提议。
